name: Authentication & Authorization Logic Review
description: Source code review focused on authentication and authorization logic. Covers session management implementation, RBAC/ABAC enforcement, middleware and decorator patterns, credential handling, multi-tenancy isolation, and business logic flaws in access control.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to authentication or authorization logic review

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands common auth/authz implementation patterns and flaws
evidence: Can explain session management, token-based auth, and RBAC at the code level
Understands how missing authorization checks lead to IDOR and privilege escalation
Familiar with common auth bypass patterns in web frameworks

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews basic auth/authz code under supervision
evidence: Identified missing authorization checks in controller/route handlers
Reviewed session management code for common flaws (fixation, weak tokens)
Traced authentication flows to identify bypass opportunities
Findings reviewed by authorized reviewer

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently reviews auth/authz implementations across frameworks
evidence: Independently reviewed auth/authz code on 5+ engagements
Identifies inconsistent authorization enforcement across endpoints
Reviews JWT creation, validation, and claims processing code
Maps authorization matrices from code and identifies gaps
Passed proficiency assessment on auth/authz logic review

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Reviews complex auth architectures; identifies subtle logic flaws
evidence: Reviews multi-tenancy isolation code for cross-tenant data access
Identifies business logic vulnerabilities in multi-step authorization workflows
Reviews SSO integration code (SAML, OIDC) for implementation flaws
Mentors junior reviewers on auth/authz review methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on auth/authz code patterns; develops review methodology
evidence: Published research on authentication or authorization code vulnerabilities
Developed the lab's auth/authz review methodology and checklists
Reviews custom authentication protocols at the implementation level
Trains teams on auth/authz code review
